races.display_title: Support The Royal British Legion Poppy Appeal Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: The market should reveal plenty here but the vote goes to French recruit MERRY WOOD who looked a good prospect when making a winning start for Olly Murphy in a Huntingdon bumper in the spring. races.verdict: Gordon Elliott has a remarkable record in this race, winning 9 of the last 10 renewals, and he has an excellent chance of adding to that tally with BALLYFAD , who is comfortably the best of these over hurdles and was an impressive winner on his sole start in a point. It's probably significant that French-recruit Matin Midi et Soir was sent off favourite when down the field in the Grade 1 Champion Juvenile Hurdle at the Punchestown Festival, and he rates as the primary threat. BALLYFAD (IRE) MATIN MIDI ET SOIR (FR) PORT AUTHORITY (IRE)

races.verdict: PREMIER DIVISION has shaped with plenty of promise on all 3 bumper outings to date, posting his best effort yet when second at Punchestown in the spring, a big move to get to the front-running winner seemingly telling late on. He sets a high standard stepping back in trip and firmly rates the one to beat. Passenger in first-time cheekpieces, Nine Toes Tim and Rokanako are others fancied to feature.
